scope: owned offscreen Command clipboard opt-in and Copy recovery; no devices, clipboard or foreground

labels.text: Select text and hold Ctrl+Win+Alt. Wait for the Command label, then speak a short editing instruction. Release to edit; Esc cancels. Read-only selections produce an edit to copy. This Pro feature uses a separate local editing model. Dictation cleanup can stay off.
Pro tier available. Download or verify the model, enable Command and Save Settings.

For unsupported selections, fallback uses ordinary Ctrl+C after you release the shortcut. Windows clipboard history and sync settings apply. If the original selection cannot be verified for replacement, the edit opens in a separate window with Copy.
